_doc: Opt-in FPR (xmm) routing of load results in Stage 2 (parsexml.py pass5_emit_llvm, fpr_cfg). Copy the 'fpr' object into a run config's top-level 'fpr' key; pipeline.py phase_llvm passes it to batch_generate.py --fpr-config. Each routed load becomes 'movq (..),%out; movq %out,%xmmK; movq $0,%out; movq %xmmK,%out' in its own asm block (the zeroing is needed because gem5's mov2int also reads its int destination). Absent or enabled=false: output byte-identical to no option. The chosen register per load is recorded in .ann.json 'fpr'. Design: wiki/design/VOCAB_TABLES.md 'FPR routing'.
